verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion controls are a fair question for an identity-verification platform that collects PII, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack contains no documentation of retention policies, redaction, or deletion APIs. Webhook attribute blocklists (persona-docs-38) only filter what appears in webhook payloads, which is an adjacent control and not retention or deletion.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
